sloka: ररास भूमिर्न तताप भानुमान् ववौ न वायुः प्रचचाल चाचलः ।कपेः कुमारस्य च वीक्ष्य संयुगं ननाद च द्यौरुदधिश्च चुक्षुभे ।। ५.४७.१३।।।।
transliteration: rarāsa bhūmirna tatāpa bhānumān vavau na vāyuḥ pracacāla cācalaḥ ।kapeḥ kumārasya ca vīkṣya saṁyugaṁ nanāda ca dyaurudadhiśca cukṣubhe ।। 5.47.13।।।।

translations.english: Witnessing the fight between Hanuman and Prince Aksha, even the earth shrieked in agony, the Sun became dim, the wind stopped blowing, mountains were shaken, the sky thundered and even the ocean was agitated.
